headline: Meta $97.5bn equity raise, Anthropic files IPO, HSBC -7%, Brent $116.85 overnight, FOMC day 1
stance: AI funding turned to equity Monday and chips bounced; hyperscaler capex guides Oct 28-29 still decide it. Oil's diplomacy dip was gone by 4:40am ET.

news.head: Meta upsizes equity raise to $97.5bn; Nvidia takes $3bn
news.body: Common upsized to $25bn at $625, plus $12.5bn preferred and a $60bn at-the-market program from Q1 2027. Flat pre-market (~5:15am ET).

news.head: Anthropic files for Nasdaq listing; H1 revenue $16.3bn
news.body: Six-month revenue +1,304% y/y, with steep losses. Separately, a $63bn bank-financed vehicle will buy Broadcom chips to lease to it; deliveries from 2027.

news.head: HSBC -7% in London on Q3 (~5am ET)
news.body: Revenue +5% to $18.7bn, pre-tax profit +10% to $10bn, $1bn buyback. Wealth fee income flat y/y. European bank index -1.3% with it.

news.head: Celestica +17%, Whirlpool -9% after Monday's close
news.body: Celestica beat and raised: EPS $3.30 vs $2.99, revenue $5.83bn vs $5.48bn. Whirlpool lost money in Q3 and cut FY26 guidance below consensus.

implications: Hyperscaler capex is now funded in stock as well as bonds: $97.5bn of equity Monday, one $63bn chip-lease vehicle. IG supply risk eases at the margin; dilution is the shareholder's problem.
Tehran talks took Brent to $114.85 by ~3:15am ET; attacks took it back above $116 by ~4:40am ET. Supply risk sets the floor, diplomacy sets the ceiling.

watch.head: Durables 8:30, new home sales 10:00; FOMC day 1
watch.body: Consumer confidence 10:00 too. Decision Oct 28, 2pm, Chair Warsh 2:30. Hold 90% priced, December hike 82%. ECB Oct 29, BoJ Oct 30.

watch.head: Earnings before the open: Coca-Cola, Boeing, PayPal
watch.body: Also UPS, Visa, Seagate, Freeport. Boeing consensus: -$0.21 EPS on $23.84bn revenue. Hyperscaler prints Oct 28-29, all after the close.

watch.head: GDP, PCE, jobless claims Oct 29, 8:30
watch.body: Q3 GDP advance and September PCE the same morning, 18 hours after the Fed statement. Employment cost index Friday, 8:30. Midterms Nov 3.

watch.head: Israel votes Oct 28; Tehran talks continue
watch.body: Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials met Iran Monday; all 4 agreed to keep talking. A vessel burned in Hormuz overnight; Houthi drones hit Saudi Tuesday.

sections.title: Macro & Rates
bullets: Tehran talks Monday with Saudi, Turkish and Pakistani officials; Houthis claimed strikes on Saudi pipeline pump stations and Riyadh airport. Brent $116.85, +0.9% (~4:40am ET).
2y auction Monday: $69bn at 4.708%, cover 2.59 vs 2.62 average. 10y 4.98% overnight (~5:45am ET). Fed, ECB and BoJ all expected to hold; BoC priced for a 25bp hike.
DXY 102.21, a 12-day high (~4am ET); euro 1.1154, yen 157.75 (~5:40am ET). Gold $3,995 (~5am ET). TTF touched EUR100/MWh Monday, the top of its 3-year range.
sections.positioning: COT, Oct 20: WTI specs 14th percentile with spot at the 97th; funds are still not long this rally. 2y specs 99th for 13 weeks, background into the FOMC.

sections.title: Equity Markets
bullets: Equal-weight S&P -0.8% Monday on a cap-weighted up day; SOX +2.8%, biggest gain in a month. Narrow and chip-led, 1 day before the first hyperscaler print.
Futures (~5:15am ET): S&P +0.05%, Nasdaq 100 flat, Dow +0.14%. Stoxx 600 -0.4%, FTSE -1% (~5am ET). Nikkei +1.7%, Kospi +3.1% at the close.
36% of the S&P 500 reports this week; Q3 EPS growth consensus +30% y/y. Capex guides Oct 28-29 after the close set the chip bid, not the Fed.
sections.positioning: COT, Oct 20, unchanged 3 to 5 weeks: Russell 2000 specs 100th percentile, Nasdaq 100 97th, VIX shorts 4th. Background into the prints, not a trigger.

sections.title: Credit & Liquidity
bullets: IG issuance passed 2020's full-year record Monday: $1.76tn YTD. October is the slowest month of the year at ~$79bn; issuers are waiting on the window.
IG OAS ended last week near its 2026 wide. The 20bp+ drop in the 10y from its high has not reached borrowers' coupons.
Weekly CDS volume on 7 AI-linked issuers averaged $9bn+ in September vs under $2bn in July. Banks hedging data-center exposure; the 1,100bp names are the debt-dependent ones.
sections.positioning: COT, Oct 20: HY specs 13th percentile, -15 points on the week; dealer IG inventory 19th. The equity window on Monday takes supply off the IG calendar.
